label: Slope Hill riparian site
description: A historic WRT planting-day location beside the creek and cycle trail, accessed from Speargrass Flat Road along Slope Hill Road. Its count covers the Road planting part; the separate Coronation and HGF areas remain unlocated.
coordinateMethod: Official WRT Spring 2022 event pin beside the riparian site. The larger ledger group also includes Coronation and HGF areas; this point is not their boundary or centroid. Current access is about 1 km along Slope Hill Road from Speargrass Flat Road.

label: Whitechapel Reserve
description: WRT’s historic planting-day location on Whitechapel Road, Arrow Junction, beside the Queenstown Trail. The reserve’s planting areas extend beyond this reference point.
coordinateMethod: Official WRT Spring 2022 planting-site pin on Whitechapel Road, Arrow Junction. QLDC reserve beside the cycle trail. Approximate reference point, not the reserve boundary or its internal planting areas.

label: Lake Hayes South planting area
description: A reference within the council-mapped Lake Hayes South planting area beside the highway. The council identifies it as a WRT keystone site. This current footprint does not define the historical planting boundary.
coordinateMethod: Representative interior point of official QLDC Community Planting polygon 1845 in WGS84. Its local-origin signed-ring centroid lies outside the concave polygon, so use the midpoint of the widest interior horizontal slice at centroid latitude (-44.99487952575074, 168.8018652576946); the rounded point is verified inside. Attributes explicitly name Lake Hayes South, Lake Hayes–Arrow Junction Highway and Whakatipu Reforestation Trust keystone site – Community/Volunteer Agreement. Stronger direct WRT-site evidence than the earlier ORC broader wetland centre. Current mapped footprint, not the full historical parcel 9A boundary.

label: Lake Hayes Pavilion planting area
description: A reference within a council-mapped WRT planting area below Lake Hayes Pavilion. The council records first planting here in spring 2023. The current footprint does not define the full historical planting boundary.
coordinateMethod: Representative interior point of official QLDC Community Planting polygon 1844, the largest mapped WRT Pavilion polygon. Local-origin signed-ring WGS84 centroid (-44.990670801075645, 168.8082373758633); rounded point verified inside the polygon. Attributes explicitly identify Lake Hayes Pavilion / Showgrounds and WRT keystone site; first plantings Spring 2023. Adjacent polygons 5601 / 10004 identify Spring 2025 planting but do not shift this point. More direct planting-area evidence than the former building coordinate. Current footprint, not all historical parcel 9G plantings.

label: Jardine Park / Nursery Reference Gardens
description: Jean Malpas Community Nursery on Poplar Drive is a navigation reference for the surrounding native Reference Gardens. The marker identifies the nursery venue, rather than the boundary of the planted gardens.
coordinateMethod: WRT organizer-published nursery venue coordinates on Eventbrite (-45.0453584,168.6941158), rounded four decimals. QLDC2022 tree replacement approval confirms expansion of its educational garden and library of native plants near the nursery; TreesThatCount2020 also confirms nursery reference gardens. The venue is an approximate navigation reference for parcel23; it does not mark a surveyed garden centroid. Excludes Track Entrance23A and Welcome Forest23B.

label: Bush Creek
description: A historic WRT planting-day location near Arrowtown’s Chinese Settlement. The group also includes separate school and reserve locations.
coordinateMethod: Official WRT Spring 2022 event-map KML point for Bush Creek Planting Site, rounded to four decimal places. Historic event reference near the Chinese Settlement, not a boundary or a point for the separate school parcels.

label: Feehly Hill / Arrowtown Cemetery
description: The cemetery is a landmark for WRT plantings on the hillside behind it. Additional planting areas lie near Manse Road and the Powder Magazine.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of the official QLDC Arrowtown Cemetery polygon in WGS84.

label: Peace Park
description: A council-mapped WRT restoration area on the Frankton foreshore. This reference point does not include the separate Frankton Beach and Boyes Crescent areas.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Community Planting feature 6401 in WGS84; not a reconciliation of all historical WRT planting records.

label: Harvest Gardens
description: The gardens at 201 Gorge Road have native planting along their southern fence. The marker shows a nearby address reference.
coordinateMethod: OSM address node 12009361230 resolved via Nominatim; street address independently corroborated by Charities Services CC40889.

label: Alpine Retreat
description: A road reference within the Alpine Retreat community, accessed via Moke Lake Road. Restoration extends onto shared common land nearby.
coordinateMethod: Published Nominatim representative coordinate of OSM road way 223291862.

label: Ziptrek / Bob’s Peak
description: A reference point within Ziptrek’s tour area above Queenstown, where WRT-supported restoration has taken place. Individual planting patches are not shown.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of Tour Area polygon in official Ziptrek map embedded at https://www.ziptrek.co.nz/location/ .

label: The Rees lakefront
description: A council-mapped community planting area on the Frankton Track below The Rees Hotel. This is one of several separate places grouped under Gorge Road area.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Community Planting feature 10506 in WGS84; adjacent 10507 also maps planting.

label: Morning Star Reserve
description: A broad reference for Morning Star Beach Recreation Reserve beside the Shotover River. WRT-supported planting occupies a plateau within the reserve; this point does not mark the plateau or an entrance.
coordinateMethod: Published location field of iNaturalist reserve place 89383.

label: Shotover Wetland
description: A reference within the council’s wetland and recreation zone east of the Shotover–Kawarau confluence. Most Shotover Primary records relate to this wetland, with separate planting on school grounds.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Structure Plans feature 448, Activity 5d - Open Space - Wetland, in WGS84.

label: Quail Rise / Jim’s Way
description: WRT’s historic planting-day pin for the Jim’s Way community restoration area at Quail Rise. Planting extends along the reserve beyond this point.
coordinateMethod: Official WRT Spring Planting 2022 KML placemark Quail Rise Community Planting (Jim’s Way): -45.000341,168.7546026. Independently corroborated by QLDC Community_Planting feature1770, native Quail Rise Restoration on Cockerell Lane; feature1771 is an orchard and was not used.

label: Tucker Beach Wildlife Reserve
description: WRT’s historic community planting-day location within Tucker Beach Wildlife Reserve. Separate Shotover River ledger parts have not been assigned to this marker.
coordinateMethod: Official WRT Spring Planting 2022 KML placemark Tucker Beach Wildlife Reserve Community Planting: -44.9820806,168.7406139. Applies to Tucker Beach parcel28 only; the Shotover River parts28A and28B, plus unresolved river records, cannot be located confidently from public evidence.

label: Gibbston Community Reserve
description: The community reserve on Coal Pit Road is the named location in the planting ledger. This marker is a reserve reference point rather than a mapped planting patch.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Open_Spaces polygon OBJECTID548, SITENME Gibbston Community Reserve, ROAD Coal Pit Road, WGS84 centroid -45.0252884111,168.9553161222. Ledger explicitly names GIBBSTON RESERVE (COAL PIT ROAD). Important: Xyst Coal Pit Road point -45.0365272,168.9473839 is a road assessment location over1km away and was not used.

label: Kawarau Gorge Suspension Bridge
description: The historic AJ Hackett bungy bridge is the landmark named in the Kawarau Bridge records. Swiftburn plantings are a separate ledger part and are not counted at this marker.
coordinateMethod: IPENZ primary engineering heritage report,29March2011,page3 explicitly publishes structure centre latitude -45.009 longitude168.899 and identifies AJ Hackett bungy use. Matches ledger KAWARAU BRIDGE AJ HACKET / parcel18A. Coordinates have only three decimal places in the source. Swiftburn parcel18 is separate and excluded.

label: Rotary Tucker Beach Trail
description: The start of the Rotary Tucker Beach Trail near the Old Lower Shotover Bridge is a navigation landmark for planting along the trail. The planting history does not identify a particular section of this 3.2 km route.
coordinateMethod: QLDC Tracks_and_Trails feature6804,TRAILNME Tucker Beach Trail; southern endpoint -44.9972735172,168.7561901201. Rotary primary source describes a3.2km walk/cycle trail from its restored old Shotover suspension bridge along Tucker Beach Road and subsequent native plantings. This is an endpoint navigation reference, not a planting-area centroid. It is distinct from Tucker Beach Wildlife Reserve’s western WRT event pin.

label: Kelvin Peninsula / Earnslaw Slipway
description: The Earnslaw Slipway reserve is the named landmark for the Slipway / Project Crimson planting records. This reference point covers that part of the ledger only.
coordinateMethod: QLDC Community_Planting feature10516,SITENME Earnslaw Slipway,ROAD Kelvin Peninsula Road. Polygon centroid -45.0404277696,168.6767485104. QLDC Chapter38 section38.4.3 recognises the established native plantings at Kelvin Peninsula Slipway Informal Recreation Reserve. Applies only to historical parcel22A.

label: Kelvin Peninsula / Queenstown Golf Club
description: Queenstown Golf Club occupies the head of Kelvin Peninsula. This is a broad course reference for the golf-course planting records; it does not identify which hole or planting area.
coordinateMethod: WRT2024impact report names Kelvin Peninsula Golf Course as a supported community planting project; ledger parcel22B says KP-GOLF COURSE / Kelvin Heights Golf Course. Official Queenstown Golf Club address759PeninsulaRoad corroborates identity. OSM Nominatim geocode of named golf_course way89381653: -45.0429512,168.6708062, a broad course reference rather than clubhouse/planting centroid.

label: Glenorchy Lagoon Walkway
description: A public reference point on the lagoon walkway near Glenorchy’s waterfront. Historical lagoon and walkway planting extends around the wetlands beyond this point.
coordinateMethod: Manaaki Whenua/New Zealand Fungarium primary georeferenced specimen PDD108570 records Glenorchy Lagoon Walkway at WGS84 -44.849922,168.382257. DOC confirms the northern town walkway and Mull Street access; Glenorchy Community Association2019planting event identifies start of Lagoon Walkway and WRT support. Point is a published walkway locality, not a recorded WRT planting pin. Applies to lagoon/walkway parcel1 only.

label: Glenorchy Lakefront / Wharf
description: The wharf is a landmark beside Glenorchy’s lakefront planting area. The marker shows the wharf and does not map individual shoreline planting patches.
coordinateMethod: Glenorchy Community Association2019planting event says WRT provided200plants for waterfront planting. July2015GCAminutes identify north end of Wharf Shed beside walkway entrance as proposed WRT plantings. OSM named Glenorchy Wharf way1289096084 geocodes -44.8515213,168.3815220. Applies only to separate lakefront parcel1C; lagoon parcel1 is represented separately.

label: Pigeon Island / Wāwāhi Waka
description: The island in northern Lake Whakatipu is a separate part of the Glenorchy planting history. This broad island reference does not show the restoration plots or landing points.
coordinateMethod: QLDC Open_Spaces polygon873,SITENME Pigeon Island Reserve (MBO); polygon centroid WGS84 -44.9227329907,168.3964913373. QLDC primary page confirms the island north in Lake Whakatipu and privately owned water transport for access. WRT2024impact report corroborates Whakatipu Islands Reforestation Trust support. Applies only to ledger Pigeon Island parcel1E.

label: Glenorchy School
description: The school on Oban Street is a separate part of Glenorchy’s planting history. This marker locates the school grounds rather than its planting patch.
coordinateMethod: Official school website confirms71ObanStreet,Glenorchy; Education Counts institution3955 independently confirms identity onObanStreet. OSM named school polygonway466602386 geocodes WGS84 -44.8506749,168.3870099. Applies only to historical GY SCHL parcel1A. This is a grounds reference, not a recorded planting point.

label: Widgeon Park
description: A reference within Widgeon Park below Lake Hayes Estate. Native planting at the base of Widgeon Place is documented by the residents association. The separate Lake Hayes Estate Trail records are not located by this marker.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of official QLDC Open Spaces polygon 1051, Widgeon Park (MBO), in WGS84. This named reserve corresponds to Widgeon Place in parcel 10; it is a broad reference, not the historic planting patch. Excludes parcel 10A (LHE Trail) because no exact trail segment is documented.

label: Queenstown Primary School
description: The school at 20 Robins Road is a reference for the school-ground planting records. The marker does not locate individual school planting patches. Visit arrangements belong to the school.
coordinateMethod: Nominatim published representative coordinate of OSM school grounds way 150605658 (-45.0276448,168.6587305), rounded to four decimals. Official school site confirms 20 Robins Road. Includes only parcel 4; excludes Queenstown Hill and Kerry Drive Reserve.

label: Kerry Drive Reserve
description: A reference within the council-mapped Kerry Drive Reserve. This marker covers the Kerry Drive records; Queenstown Hill and the primary school are separate parts of the ledger group.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of official QLDC Open Spaces polygon 659, Kerry Drive Reserve, in WGS84. Native planting by the Kerry Drive and Ballarat Street Restoration Group is also recorded in the Queenstown Lakes Carbon Zero discussion paper. Only parcel 4B is counted; not an exact planting patch.

label: Kiwi Park
description: A reference within Kiwi Park, the wildlife sanctuary on Brecon Street below the gondola. It marks the park grounds rather than an individual planting area. Visitor entry is managed by the park.
coordinateMethod: Nominatim published representative coordinate of OSM Kiwi Birdlife Park way 248085277 (-45.0274256,168.6570760), rounded to four decimals. The operator confirms Brecon Street below the gondola; DOC-hosted 2025 consent confirms 51 Brecon Street. A park landmark, not a precise historic planting location.

label: Bridesdale Bush / Hayes Creek
description: A reference within a council-mapped Bridesdale Bush Trust planting area on Hayes Creek Road. Council identifies the wider restoration project as supported by WRT. The individual planting patch behind the ledger’s Bridesdale records is not established.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid computed after translating polygon vertices to a local origin to avoid floating-point cancellation of official QLDC Community Planting polygon 1748, whose notes say maintained by Bridesdale Bush Trust and planted Spring 2023, in WGS84. QLDC Scuttlebutt June/July 2024 page 13 corroborates WRT support. Ledger Bridesdale records are Autumn/Spring 2025; this is a nearby project reference, not a claim that the 2025 plants occupy the 2023 polygon.

label: Matakauri Wetland
description: The published centre of Matakauri Wetland, east of Gorge Road and Industrial Place. It represents the wider wetland; the particular 2026 planting area and an entrance are not established.
coordinateMethod: ORC publishes wetland centre NZTM E1258480 N5006030 (EPSG2193). Projected to WGS84 through ArcGIS GeometryServer yields longitude168.66556001708514, latitude-45.016866953313325; rounded four decimals. Broad wetland reference, not the council Community Planting10517 polygon to the north or the specific 2026 ledger plantings.

label: Arrow River / Morven Ferry Reserve
description: Morven Ferry Reserve is a reference beside the Arrow River and trail at Arrow Junction. The historic register calls this planting group Arrow River Track – Arrow Junction. The exact 2015 planting stretch is not established.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of official QLDC Open Spaces polygon 797, Morven Ferry Reserve on Arrow Junction Road, WGS84. Historic source register alias ARROW RIVER TRACK - ARROW JUNCTION establishes the relevant river/trail locality (docs/discovery/04d_sites_variants.csv). QLDC plan section2.23 confirms the reserve adjoins Arrow River and Queenstown Trail passes its upper terrace. This is an inferred locality reference, not a verified 2015 planting point.

label: Walter Peak — Beach Point
description: Beach Point campsite and public lakeshore walkway are landmarks for the wider Walter Peak restoration area. The historic WRT planting was on adjacent DOC land; this point does not identify the individual planting patch.
coordinateMethod: DOC campsite guide publishes Beach Point at Walter Peak at latitude -45.10341, longitude 168.54149. RealNZ identifies WRT volunteer planting on adjacent DOC land in September 2017, matching the ledger season; the campsite is a public reference, not the verified planting patch.

label: Wye Creek — Main Wall area
description: A climbing-area reference near Main Wall, where Queenstown Climbing Club describes its native bush restoration work. Plantings extend around the climbing area; the marker is not a planting boundary or a car park.
coordinateMethod: Published climber coordinates for The Mission at Main Wall: -45.14186,168.76992, corroborated by Proud Monkey, Dream Thing and Aratika route records. The club explicitly identifies native restoration around Main Wall. This is a crag reference, not a surveyed planting patch.

label: Jardines Boulder Field
description: A reference for the named boulder field on Remarkables Station, beside SH6. The exact position of the ledger’s native plantings within this area has not been established.
coordinateMethod: The named Jardines bouldering-area map publishes -45.095774,168.764851. QEII confirms the identity and SH6 access. Used as a broader area landmark, not a planting pin; QEII website embedded map coordinates were rejected because they point far south of the named boulder field.

label: Moke Lake campsite
description: DOC’s published campsite location corresponds to the ledger’s Moke Lake Camp name. It is a campsite reference rather than the exact position of the historic plantings.
coordinateMethod: Direct published DOC latitude -44.99811782, longitude168.57308923 (also NZTM E1251305 N5007714). The source ledger says ML CAMP / Moke Lake Camp, matching this public campsite.

label: Lower Shotover Conservation Area
description: A reference point inside the DOC conservation area along the Shotover River east of Arthurs Point. The historic planting patch is unknown; this marker represents the named reserve rather than its planting boundary.
coordinateMethod: Interior point derived from DOC Public Conservation Land polygon NaPALIS_ID2804651, Conservation Area - Lower Shotover, unitF41048. The area centroid falls outside this narrow winding polygon; used the midpoint of the widest interior segment at centroid latitude -44.98770238, yielding longitude168.72800053. This is a reserve reference, not the unknown 2015 planting patch.

label: KingsView School
description: KingsView School at 14 Yewlett Crescent, Frankton, is a reference for the school planting records. The marker identifies the school rather than an individual planting patch.
coordinateMethod: Nominatim representative coordinate of OSM school way 384923492 (-45.0176656, 168.7279115), with school name and 14 Yewlett Crescent address independently confirmed by the school and Education Counts institution 633. Rounded to four decimal places. School landmark, not verified planting boundary.

label: Jardine Park / Welcome Forest
description: A council-mapped WRT native planting area in the southern part of Jardine Park. The council development plan identifies Welcome Forest plantings here. This point represents one planting patch, rather than the full forest boundary.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of official QLDC Community Planting polygon1778, native plantings by Whakatipu Reforestation Trust, at -45.04757644852401,168.6888288832655. Calculated after translating polygon to local origin to avoid cancellation. March2025 Jardine Park Concept Development Plan section1.1 places Welcome Forest at southernpark; section1.2/p5 identifies its native planting patches west/southwest of nursery. Polygon1778 lies in this area. Approximate patch reference for parcel23B, not a mapped boundary for the full Welcome Forest.

label: Atley Downs / Atley Road Reserve
description: A public reserve reference in the Atley Downs area. The historic planting records do not identify the individual planting patch.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of official QLDC Atley Road Reserve polygon OBJECTID 393, calculated with coordinates translated to a local origin to avoid cancellation. Reference for the broader Atley Downs ledger locality, not a verified centroid of the 2015–2019 planting. APCA confirms planting at the end of Atley Road but does not locate these historic records.

label: Arthurs Point / DOC Office
description: The Cavells Building at 1 Arthurs Point Road is a landmark for the DOC Office planting records. It does not locate individual planting beds.
coordinateMethod: Queenstown Trails publishes this Google Maps link for Canyon Brewing, which occupies the ground floor of the Cavells Building below DOC. DOC concession application confirms the shared building. Resolved place coordinates -44.9875607,168.6721377, rounded to four decimals; building landmark, not planting centroid. Supporting source https://www.doc.govt.nz/globalassets/documents/getting-involved/consultations/2025/4jqt-limited/4jqt-limited-application-form.pdf and link publisher https://www.queenstowntrails.org.nz/trails/arthurs-point-trail

label: Feehly Hill / Powder Magazine
description: The historic Powder Magazine beside Malaghans Road is a landmark for the Magazine planting area at the foot of Feehly Hill.
coordinateMethod: Heritage New Zealand publishes latitude -44.9422943372709 and longitude 168.82767234528086 in its official listing location data. Rounded to four decimal places. Building landmark for the ledger Magazine locality, not an individual planting bed.

label: Feehly Hill / Manse Road
description: Manse Road Reserve is a reference on the western side of Feehly Hill. The exact historical planting patches remain unconfirmed.
coordinateMethod: Interior reference point of official QLDC Manse Road Reserve (MBO) polygon OBJECTID 745. At latitude -44.9388, intersected all polygon rings with a horizontal line and selected the midpoint of the widest interior interval (longitude168.82028708091724 to168.8203800823854), then rounded to four decimals and verified the rounded point remains inside. AVA confirms restoration associated with Manse Road and Feehly Hill. This is an interior reserve landmark, not a polygon centroid or verified WRT planting point.

label: Arrowtown Primary School
description: School grounds at 9 Chalmers Place provide a reference for the Arrowtown Primary records. The individual planting beds are not documented.
coordinateMethod: Nominatim geocoding of the OSM Arrowtown School grounds polygon returned -44.9486408,168.8393458. Official school contact information confirms 9 Chalmers Place. School grounds reference only, not a verified planting patch.

label: Derby Street Road Reserve
description: The council-mapped native planting area maintained by the Derby Street Reserve Restoration Group. Historical records are assigned to the Derby Street sub-site.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Community Planting polygon OBJECTID 1776, calculated with coordinates translated to a local origin. Official attributes identify Derby Street Road Reserve and native planting by its restoration group. Exact correspondence between the ledger 2023 allocation and the current council polygon is not verified.

label: Frankton Beach / Domain
description: A broad reference within Frankton Domain beside the beach. The Frankton Beach planting records do not identify individual shoreline planting patches.
coordinateMethod: Interior reference point of QLDC Frankton Domain polygon OBJECTID 1165. At latitude -45.0206, intersected all polygon rings with a horizontal line and selected the midpoint of the widest interior interval (longitude168.72881451297047 to168.73072394409695), then rounded to four decimals and verified the rounded point remains inside. Council describes Frankton Beach beside the Domain and BBQ area off Lake Avenue. This is a broad interior reserve landmark, not a polygon centroid or verified WRT planting point.

label: Boyes Crescent residents planting
description: The council-mapped native planting area cared for by Boyes Crescent residents, separate from the Peace Park planting area.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of QLDC Community Planting polygon OBJECTID 1772, calculated with coordinates translated to a local origin. Council names Boyes Crescent Residents and native planting by residents; WRT 2024 Impact Report confirms the supported resident restoration project. Polygon reference, not each planted tree.

label: Shotover Primary / School grounds
description: The school at 57 Stalker Road is a reference for internal school planting records. The separate Shotover Wetland marker covers wetland planting.
coordinateMethod: Official civil-defence community response plan pages 22–23 publishes Shotover Primary School S45°00′21.32″ E168°46′35.45″, converted to -45.0059222,168.7765139 and rounded to four decimals. School building reference for internal-school ledger parcel20B; not the separate wetland parcel20A or exact internal planting beds.

label: Lake Hayes East / Rowing Club
description: A reference among the council-mapped planting areas beside Whakatipu Rowing Club on the eastern shore. The current mapped areas are a landmark for this ledger part, rather than its historical planting boundary.
coordinateMethod: Area-weighted centroid of four QLDC Community Planting polygons1749,1751,1781,10001 in WGS84, calculated after translating coordinates to a local origin. They explicitly name Wakatipu Rowing Club;1781 records Spring2024 club planting. Ledger9H names LakeHayesEast(RowingClub etc). Reference for the named club locality, not a verified WRT event pin or historical9H boundary.

label: Lake Hayes West / Project Gold
description: A reference within a current council-mapped Project Gold planting area on the western Lake Hayes trail. The historical West PG planting boundary is not verified.
coordinateMethod: Representative interior point of QLDC Community Planting polygon 1854, the largest of the four western-shore polygons 1851–1854 labelled Project: GOLD community plantings (MBO). Its centroid was calculated with local-origin signed-ring area weighting in WGS84, then the rounded point was verified inside the polygon. Layer SITENME is Lake Hayes South and ROAD Marshall Avenue, so this is a broad named-project/locality anchor, not a verified historical WRT footprint. QLDC April 2019 newsletter independently documents WRT Lake Hayes West planting with DOC; ledger parcel 9 is West PG. Eastern-shore Project Gold polygon 1855 is excluded.
